question: In which of the following years did the Indian Premier League begin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2008.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Premier League **(IPL) began in the year** 2008.**
 
• IPL is a** professional Twenty20 cricket league** in India which is governed by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).**
 
• The Indian Premier League was founded by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in** 2007 **with the first season played in 2008.
 
• The league consists of **eight teams** representing different cities in India, and each team is owned by different franchisees.
 
• The IPL is known for its **high-octane cricket matches,** star-studded line-ups, and extravagant opening ceremonies.
 
• The league has also been a platform for** young and upcoming cricketers **to showcase their talent and earn a chance to play for the Indian cricket team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **17th** season of the Indian Premier League took place i**n 2024.**
 
• **Kolkata Knight Riders won** 2024 IPL edition.
